law.title: Limitations on backing (2)
law.text: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

timing_requirements.requirement: the violation is the instant the reversing footprint enters the intersection or crosswalk, or the heading change that carries it round the corner
backing and the region overlap must be simultaneous — reversing before the crosswalk and then driving forward through it is not this offence

observation_terms_contract: Summary required_observations are law-planning terms, not Core IDs. Map every term to measured evidence; put only supported pinned ontology IDs in config.required_atoms.

source_observation_terms.note: the footprint overlapping the intersection or crosswalk while backing
'around a street corner' — a heading change while reversing
the heading change during the reverse movement
